description:
Role: Core Java Developer
Location: NYC, NY
Duration: Fulltime

BGV will be done for the selected candidates.


Must Have Skills:

· 8+ years hands-on Java Development in Web Sphere environment

· 3+ year work experience in AgileScrum team

· Strong Core Java

· Strong J2EE in XML, JMS, JAX-WS, CXF

· Spring Framework

· Strong understanding of OOP &SOA

· Design Patterns

· Java concurrency, concurrency patterns

· Experience building thread safe code

· JUnit/Mockito, Cucumber

· Experience with IDEs such as RAD/Eclipse

· Experience building REST and SOAP web services

· SQL/PL-SQL in DB2, MySQL

· Experience with ORM tools such as iBatis and Hibernate

· Experience with scripting and working in a Linux environment

· Experience working in an Agile environment

· Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills

· Experience with tuning high volume applications

· Strong written and verbal communication skills

Good To Have:

· Spring Boot

· Spring Cloud

· Spring Security

· Spring Batch

· Spring Web Services
· Hibernet



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
